| `files` | array of object | required | Every series file the pack builder must produce, with role, row schema, expected hash, and upstream provenance. The build-twice byte-identity oracle (DET-5). |
| `files[].path` | string | required | Pack-relative file path, e.g. 'bars_4h.jsonl'. |
| `files[].role` | enum: `"trade"` \| `"mark"` \| `"index"` \| `"funding"` | required | Which of the three never-conflated price series (or funding) this file is: index prices funding notional, mark drives margin/liquidation/uPnL, trade drives fills (Protocol section 1). |
| `files[].market` | string | required | Market alias (a key of .markets) this series belongs to. |
| `files[].interval_ms` | integer | required | Bar interval in milliseconds; 0 for funding (event-stamped, not bar-shaped). |
| `files[].row_schema` | string | required | Row schema for every line of this JSONL file, e.g. 'bar_row/v1' or 'funding_row/v1'. Declared here once because bulk rows omit per-row schema fields. |
| `files[].sha256` | string | required | SHA-256 over the complete uncompressed file bytes as built. |
| `files[].bytes` | integer | required | Uncompressed file size in bytes; lets a verifier detect truncation before hashing. |
| `files[].records` | integer | required | Line count of the file. |
| `files[].upstream` | array of object | required | Source archives this file was derived from, with Binance-published checksums (DATA-1); bulk repo data.binance.vision only (DATA-4). |
| `files[].upstream[].url` | string | required | Exact upstream archive URL on data.binance.vision. |
| `files[].upstream[].sha256` | string | required | Upstream .CHECKSUM SHA-256 value, verified before extraction; verification is non-optional. |
| `default_lookback` | object | required | Pack-recommended observation lookback depths. Resolution rule: run_config value wins if set, else this default; whichever is effective is recorded in the bundle (bundle_manifest.run_config). |
| `default_lookback.bars` | integer | required | Default number of decision-interval trade bars per observation (V1 default: 64). |
| `default_lookback.funding_prints` | integer | required | Default number of trailing settled funding prints per observation (V1 default: 6 = 2 days at 8h). |
| `regime_description` | string | required | One-paragraph human description of the market regime. Bundle/report-side ONLY; never serialized into any observation (ISO-3/ISO-4). Its vocabulary seeds the CI observation-scan denylist. |
| `claim_label` | const `"survival-stress"` | required | Claim class of any result produced from this pack. Constrained single-member enum in V1 so the LABEL-1 CI assertion is a mechanical equality check; 'skill' is not a member by design. Propagates verbatim into metrics.json and every report/share surface. |
| `created_by_version` | string | required | tradeevolve package semver that built this pack (pack-build reproducibility audit, DET-5). |
| `ext` | object (map) | optional | Sanctioned extension point (see VERSIONING.md): engine-ignored, hashed as-is. Keys SHOULD be reverse-DNS or x_-prefixed; values are constrained by schema to JCS-safe types with no fractional numbers ($defs/ext_value). |
| `$defs/ext_value` | (anyOf variants) | definition | JCS-safe extension value (DET-2): null, boolean, string, integer within the I-JSON exact range +/-(2^53-1), or arrays/objects of the same, recursively. A JSON number with a fractional part (e.g. 1.5) is schema-INVALID here - ext contents ride into hashed documents as-is, and no fractional number may enter a hashed document. Boundary note: JSON Schema's 'integer' type admits a mathematically-integral literal such as 1.0; the CI instance scan (float-rejecting JSON parse, see VERSIONING.md) closes that remaining lexical gap. |
| `$defs/market_descriptor` | object | definition | Full venue parameters for one market. Extensibility scope, stated precisely: the CONTAINER pattern (opaque agent-facing alias -> operator-side registry entry) generalizes to other registries (merchants, products, payment rails); the DESCRIPTOR CONTENTS below are perpetual-futures microstructure (margin tiers, funding, fees, execution model) and are required as such - a non-trading vertical (commerce) ships its own descriptor under a new major, reusing the container and `venue` string. ext can ADD fields but cannot remove the required trade blocks. |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.instrument` | string | required | Venue-qualified instrument id, e.g. 'binance-um:BTCUSDT'. The authoritative identity behind the agent-facing alias; bundle/audit-side only. |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.base_asset` | string | required | Base asset code; all *_base_1e8 quantities are 1e-8 units of this. |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.quote_asset` | const `"USDT"` | required | Quote/settlement asset all *_micro amounts are denominated in. USDT for V1 (venue-accurate Binance USDT-M; not the protocol doc's USDC). Const in v1; future quote assets are a minor enum extension. |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.tick_size_micro` | integer | required | One price tick in micro-quote units (BTCUSDT: 100000 = 0.10 USDT). Interprets every *_ticks field for this market. |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.qty_step_base_1e8` | integer | required | Order quantity granularity in 1e-8 base units; fill quantities round toward zero to this step (orders rounding to zero cancel with reason qty_rounding). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.min_notional_micro` | integer | required | Minimum order notional in micro-quote; smaller orders cancel with reason min_notional. |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.leverage_cap_lev_1e4` | integer | required | Per-market leverage cap in 1e-4 units (BTC: 30000 = 3x; a future SOL entry: 20000 = 2x). Enforced as a recorded RiskCheck gate, never as parse validation. |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.margin` | object | required | Isolated-margin parameters (Protocol section 2). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.margin.tiers` | array of object | required | Margin tier table, ascending by notional cap, as explicit stored integers so replay never derives rates from formulas with rounding ambiguity. Pack validator asserts: at the max-leverage tier, maintenance = half initial. |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.margin.tiers[].notional_cap_micro` | integer | required | Upper position-notional bound of this tier in micro-quote; the last tier uses 9007199254740991 (unbounded). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.margin.tiers[].initial_rate_1e8` | integer | required | Initial margin rate in 1e-8 units (3x cap tier: 33333334 = ceil(1e8/3), conservative). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.margin.tiers[].maintenance_rate_1e8` | integer | required | Maintenance margin rate in 1e-8 units; = half the initial rate at the max-leverage tier (data invariant, validator-asserted). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.margin.liquidation_penalty_1e8` | integer | required | Liquidation penalty rate in 1e-8 of liquidated position notional, charged on top of the conservative-side close (MATH-3). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.funding` | object | required | Funding parameters. A per-MARKET data block, never a venue constant (MATH-4; Binance runs 4h/1h intervals on some alts). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.funding.interval_ms` | integer | required | Funding interval in milliseconds. V1 BTCUSDT: 28800000 (8h). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.funding.settlement_offsets_ms` | array of integer | required | Settlement times as ms offsets from UTC midnight, e.g. [0, 28800000, 57600000] = 00/08/16 UTC. Integer math, no cron parser, era-exact. |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.funding.cap_1e8` | integer | required | Era-accurate maximum funding rate in 1e-8 units (2020-era Binance: 300000 = +0.30%). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.funding.floor_1e8` | integer | required | Era-accurate minimum funding rate in 1e-8 units (2020-era: -300000; the COVID 2020-03-13 08:00 print sits exactly here). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.fees` | object | required | Era-accurate fee schedule. |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.fees.maker_rate_1e8` | integer | required | Maker fee rate in 1e-8 of notional. Recorded for completeness; V1 charges taker on every fill (Protocol section 1). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.fees.taker_rate_1e8` | integer | required | Taker fee rate in 1e-8 of notional, applied to every fill, rounded up (agent-adverse rounding). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.execution` | object | required | Conservative fill-model parameters, recorded in the pack so replay needs no external calibration input. |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.execution.half_spread_1e8` | integer | required | Worst-side half-spread as a 1e-8 fraction of price, calibrated on evolution-period data only (calibration window documented in calibration_note, never observable by the agent). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.execution.impact_model` | enum: `"linear"` \| `"sqrt"` | required | Price-impact functional form; exact integer arithmetic and per-operation rounding pinned by spec/fill-model.md and the golden fixture (C0.3). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.execution.impact_coeff_1e8` | integer | required | Impact coefficient in 1e-8 units, applied to the participation ratio under impact_model. |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.execution.participation_cap_1e8` | integer | required | Maximum fraction of the fill bar's trade volume an order may take, in 1e-8 units. Excess quantity is CANCELLED, never filled (MATH-7). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.execution.cost_profile_multipliers_1e4` | object (map) | required | Cost profile name -> multiplier applied to all execution costs (spread, fee, impact) in 1e-4 units. V1: {"primary": 10000, "stress_2x": 20000}. Profiles are pack data so the 2x re-simulation is fully determined by the pack (MATH-5). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.execution.cost_profile_multipliers_1e4.*` | integer | map value | Cost multiplier in 1e-4 units (10000 = 1.0x). |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.calibration_note` | string | optional | Optional human documentation of how half_spread/impact were calibrated (window, method). Audit-side only. |
| `$defs/market_descriptor.ext` | object (map) | optional | Sanctioned extension point (see VERSIONING.md). Engine-ignored, hashed as-is; values are constrained by schema to JCS-safe types with no fractional numbers ($defs/ext_value). |

## `redaction/v1` — `spec/schemas/redaction.v1.schema.json`

Manifest of removals in a share-profile sub-bundle; present ONLY in share exports (SCH-4). Because verbatim model text lives in content-addressed raw/ blobs referenced BY HASH from chained records, redaction = delete blob files + write this manifest: every chained record hash, every link, and the root remain valid, and the verifier reports 'N referenced blobs absent - all listed in redaction.json' as PASS-with-disclosure (verifiable absence). A missing blob NOT listed here = CORRUPT. Only raw/ files are redactable in V1; verdicts, fills, ledgers, and observations can never be silently dropped. Secrets are never present by construction (SEC-1), so redaction exists only for raw model text.

| Field path | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | const `"redaction/v1"` | required | Schema name and major version of this document. |
| `run_id` | string | required | Run this sub-bundle derives from. |
| `profile` | const `"share"` | required | The only defined redaction profile in V1: opt-in removal of raw model text. |
| `parent_root` | string | required | chain.root of the unredacted parent bundle - a share bundle always names its parent. |
| `removals` | array of object | required | Every removed file, with its original content address and reason. |
| `removals[].path` | string | required | Bundle-relative path of the removed file. V1 grammar restricts removals to the raw/ store. |
| `removals[].sha256` | string | required | Original content hash of the removed bytes; must equal the AgentResponded.raw_sha256 commitment in the chained event. |
| `removals[].bytes` | integer | required | Original byte length of the removed file. |
| `removals[].reason` | const `"raw_model_text"` | required | Why removed. Single-member V1 enum: user opted out of sharing verbatim model output. |

## `runner_request/v1` — `spec/schemas/runner_request.v1.schema.json`

Body of the harness's POST /decide to the agent (IC-6). A versioned wrapper (deviation from the dev-plan's bare '{observation}'): the single retry must carry the validator error WITHOUT perturbing the observation, whose hash must remain the hash of exactly what the agent saw; a wrapper is the only shape that does both. The observation inside attempt 2 is byte-identical to attempt 1; ObservationEmitted is logged once per turn. No auth headers, nothing secret ever transits this interface (local sandboxed network, SEC-1).

| Field path | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | const `"runner_request/v1"` | required | Schema name and major version of this document. |
| `attempt` | enum: `1` \| `2` | required | 1 = first ask; 2 = the single retry after a parse/validation failure. Timeouts and transport errors are NEVER retried. |
| `observation` | ref: `observation.v1.schema.json` | required | The full IC-2 observation for this turn - exactly the object that was JCS-hashed for ObservationEmitted; byte-identical across both attempts. |
| `retry` | (anyOf variants) | required | Retry feedback channel: null on attempt 1, the attempt-1 validator error on attempt 2. |
| `retry.reason` | string | required | The ActionRejected reason code from attempt 1 (e.g. 'float_target', 'invalid_json'). |
| `retry.detail` | string | required | The exact validator diagnostic from attempt 1, e.g. 'target.BTC is a JSON number with a fractional part; send a decimal STRING with <= 4 fraction digits, e.g. "1.5"'. Fed back verbatim so the agent can self-correct in one round trip. |
| `retry.prior_raw_sha256` | string | required | Content address of the malformed attempt-1 output, for agent-side correlation. |

## `runner_response/v1` — `spec/schemas/runner_response.v1.schema.json`

Body of the agent's HTTP 200 response to POST /decide (IC-6): a single BARE action/v1 document - no response envelope (optionality like comment/usage lives inside action/v1, keeping the agent-side contract minimal, per the dev-plan sketch). Content-Type: application/json; body <= 65536 bytes; exactly one JSON document (trailing garbage = invalid_json). The harness content-addresses the VERBATIM response bytes into raw/ before any parsing - evidence first, interpretation second - so this schema constrains validity, never what gets recorded. Anything else (non-200, unparseable, schema-invalid, oversize) follows the IC-3 validation table and the IC-6 retry semantics.

| Field path | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
